svg.aria-label: Data flow of the Power BI report fix. 1 Flat export: data/input/sales_flat.csv, 2,098,633 rows and 35 columns, joined from 4 Contoso CSVs in the demo. 2 Notebook: analysis.ipynb runs DuckDB SQL, writes output/sales.csv with 11 columns and the check numbers in 06-checks.md. 3 Power Query: the staging query Sales Flat types the file and feeds Sales, Customer and Product. 4 Star schema: the Sales fact with 7 columns and the Date, Customer and Product dimensions, auto date/time off. 5 DAX: 10 measures, no calculated columns. 6 Fixed report: Overview and Products, 19 visuals, every number checked against 06-checks.md. Branch from the flat export: the slow report loads sales_flat.csv as is, 35 plus 6 calculated columns and 10 row-by-row measures.
svg.title: Data flow
